file.label: File…
file.tooltip: Track a video, an image, or recorded values (JSON)

mirrorView.label: Mirror view
mirrorView.tooltip: Show the video like a mirror (display only; the values do not change)

landmarks.label: Landmarks
landmarks.tooltip: Draw the landmarks (face oval, eyes, brows, lips) over the video

swapSides.label: Swap sides
swapSides.tooltip: Swap Left / Right and the signs of yaw and roll. Use it to move the model like your reflection, or when the video is already mirrored (such as a mirrored virtual camera)

stopEyeBlink.label: Stop eye blink
stopEyeBlink.tooltip: Stop the model's automatic eye blink while tracking (the eyes follow the tracking only)

trackBody.label: Body (shoulders)
trackBody.tooltip: Also track the body orientation and the shoulders with MediaPipe Pose Landmarker. Turn it off for lighter detection; the body then follows the head

smoothing.label: Smoothing
smoothing.tooltip: How much to suppress jitter (One Euro filter). Stronger is smoother but lags

calibrate.label: Calibrate
calibrate.tooltip: Use the current face as neutral (facing forward, no expression)

tuning.title: Tuning (sensitivity and thresholds)
tuning.uncalibrated: Not calibrated: the values still include your neutral face. Calibrate first to tune the movement from neutral
tuning.calibrated: Values after calibration and before smoothing (before tuning → after tuning)

gain.label: Sensitivity
gain.tooltip: Multiplies the angle. Higher makes a small head movement turn the character more

deadZone.label: Dead zone
deadZone.tooltip: Angles within this range around neutral are ignored (stops small jitter). Outside it, movement continues smoothly from zero

gainSeparate.label: Separate sensitivity by direction
gainSeparate.tooltip: Use a different sensitivity for each direction (left and right, up and down), for example when the camera is to one side and turning one way reads smaller. Turning it on copies the current sensitivity to both directions

gainToward.label: Sensitivity ({{direction}})
gainToward.tooltip: Multiplies the angle in this direction (after the dead zone). The dead zone is shared by both directions

low.label: Fully open at
low.tooltip: Eye closure at or below this counts as fully open

high.label: Fully closed at
high.tooltip: Eye closure at or above this counts as fully closed. Lower it if your eyes never fully close in tracking

eyeBlinkSeparate.label: Separate left and right eyelids
eyeBlinkSeparate.tooltip: Set the thresholds of the left and right eyes separately (when only one eye does not close fully). Turning it on copies the current thresholds to both eyes

low.label: Still below
low.tooltip: Gaze at or below this does not move the eyes in that direction (stops small jitter)

high.label: Fully looking at
high.tooltip: Gaze at or above this counts as looking all the way in that direction. Lower it if the eyeballs never reach the edge

eyeLookSeparate.label: Separate gaze by direction
eyeLookSeparate.tooltip: Set the thresholds for looking up, down, left and right separately (for example when looking down never lowers the eyeballs fully). Left and right are your own. Turning it on copies the current thresholds to every direction

low.label: Not wide below
low.tooltip: Eye widening at or below this counts as not widened (so the usual eye opening does not widen the eyes)

high.label: Fully wide at
high.tooltip: Eye widening at or above this counts as fully widened. Lower it if widening your eyes barely registers

eyeWideSeparate.label: Separate left and right wide eyes
eyeWideSeparate.tooltip: Set the widening thresholds of the left and right eyes separately (when only one eye barely widens). Turning it on copies the current thresholds to both eyes

low.label: Closed at
low.tooltip: Mouth opening at or below this counts as closed (ignores slight opening)

high.label: Fully open at
high.tooltip: Mouth opening at or above this counts as fully open. Lower it to open the mouth wide with a small movement

low.label: Not closed below
low.tooltip: Lip closure at or below this counts as not closed

high.label: Fully closed at
high.tooltip: Lip closure at or above this counts as fully closed (subtracts the most from the mouth opening). Lower it if the mouth stays slightly open when you close it

low.label: Still below
low.tooltip: Smile and frown at or below this do not move the mouth

high.label: Fully moved at
high.tooltip: Smile and frown at or above this count as the mouth corners fully raised (or lowered). Lower it if your smile barely raises the corners

mouthFormSeparate.label: Separate smile and frown
mouthFormSeparate.tooltip: Set the thresholds of the smile and the frown separately (for example when you can smile but the corners barely lower). Turning it on copies the current thresholds to both

low.label: Still below
low.tooltip: Moving the mouth sideways at or below this does not move the mouth (stops slight jitter)

high.label: Fully moved at
high.tooltip: Moving the mouth sideways at or above this counts as fully moved. Lower it if the mouth barely moves when you shift it sideways

mouthSideSeparate.label: Separate mouth left and right
mouthSideSeparate.tooltip: Set the thresholds for moving the mouth to the left and to the right separately (for example when it barely moves to one side). Left and right are your own. Turning it on copies the current thresholds to both

low.label: Not puffed below
low.tooltip: Cheek puff at or below this counts as not puffed (so just closing the mouth does not puff the cheeks)

high.label: Fully puffed at
high.tooltip: Cheek puff at or above this counts as fully puffed. Lower it if puffing your cheeks barely registers

low.label: Still below
low.tooltip: Eyebrow movement at or below this does not move the eyebrows

high.label: Fully moved at
high.tooltip: Eyebrow movement at or above this counts as fully moved. Lower it if your eyebrows move only a little

browSeparate.label: Separate raise and lower
browSeparate.tooltip: Set the thresholds for raising and lowering the eyebrows separately (for example when raising reads well but lowering barely does). Turning it on copies the current thresholds to both

reset.label: Reset to defaults
reset.tooltip: Reset all sensitivities, dead zones and thresholds (and join the left and right eyelids and wide eyes, and the directions of thresholds and sensitivity)

record.label: Record
record.tooltip: Record the detected values (save them as JSON to replay without a camera)

body.label: Body
body.tooltip: Leaning and shoulders are used after calibration

errors.noMediaDevices: Cameras are not available here (navigator.mediaDevices is missing)

camera.notAllowed: The camera was not allowed (check the OS and app settings)
camera.busy: Cannot open the camera (another app may be using it)

errors.modelMissing: The MediaPipe model is not bundled (run `pnpm mediapipe` in the app's directory)
errors.poseModelMissing: The body tracking model is not bundled (run `pnpm mediapipe` in the app's directory). Tracking the face only
